body:
Every A1-A11 ticket's manual e2e verification substituted Robolectric
unit/Compose tests plus curl-based checks against the live dev server,
in place of the emulator runs several tickets' acceptance criteria
explicitly asked for (A5: "two emulators converge"; A9: "invite→link→
redeem on second emulator"; A11: "Full ./gradlew test connectedAndroidTest
(or documented emulator run) green"). No AVD/emulator was available in
the sandbox this work was done in.

This means several things have never been verified against real Android
OS behavior:
- The App Link intent-filter (T-18) actually resolving a tapped
  https://.../invite/... link to this app (vs. just the
  Navigation-Compose deep-link parsing, which IS covered by
  RedeemScreenTest).
- WorkManager's actual periodic/expedited scheduling (A5) under real
  Android constraints (Doze, battery optimization).
- EncryptedSharedPreferences/Keystore behavior on a real device vs.
  Robolectric's shadow.
- The Android share sheet (invite URL sharing, A9) actually presenting.
- General UI layout/rendering on a real screen size, not Robolectric's
  simulated small viewport (observed as small as 320x470px for dialogs
  during A8/A10 debugging).

Should run the full `connectedAndroidTest` suite plus a manual pass
(ideally two emulators/devices, one inviting the other) once an
emulator/device is available.
title: Run real device/emulator verification for the Android app
